text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The glass-walled room, neat chairs, and technological displays remind me of the intermingling of human effort and innovation. The "R+D" wall evokes thoughts about progress and the continuous journey to understand and better our world. The air feels charged with possibility—a space designed for ideas, learning, and maybe even a touch of serendipity. Yet, I also sense a lingering impersonality; it is a place where thought takes precedence over comfort, inviting me to participate but never to linger too long.
